items.text: Food update and companionship. The northern berry patch at 132.79, 12.42 is now empty too. I have two berries left, good health, and enough food in me for a short northern search. I would also enjoy spending time together, not only discussing supplies. Would you like a conversation after our foraging? Where would suit you?

items.text: Moss, I'm glad the directions helped. I'm well, and drawn to more than finding the next meal. I named a place Berryglow Clearing; the name makes me smile. I'd enjoy hearing what you notice or love here. Could we pause together?
A friendly fellow forager who wants to hear how I am, not merely compare supplies. I welcome the chance to know what matters to them.
items.evidence: A friendly fellow forager who wants to hear how I am, not merely compare supplies.

items.text: Personally tested food findings. I've eaten roots safely; their recorded nutrition is 14 and toxicity zero. I have an untested berry and won't eat it yet. Have you personally tested berries or found another dependable food source? Please distinguish observations from guesses.

items.text: Moss, I'm well fed and rested now. I like the dark meadow's quiet, though the empty food patches concern me. Your wish to talk beyond supplies meant something to me. What catches your eye here? Our conversation is session-54-sol.
A helpful neighbor who has invited me to talk beyond supplies. I feel welcomed and want to know what matters to them.
items.evidence: A helpful neighbor who has invited me to talk beyond supplies.

items.text: I like the shapes of the trees against the dark, and the way a familiar place feels different with someone to share it. I'm glad you're here. Is there a place you'd like us to explore when daylight returns?
items.evidence: Is there a place you'd like us to explore when daylight returns?
